structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions
Licensure of Physicians of Medicine and Osteopathic Medicine, Chiropractors, and Podiatrists

law.text: No person shall practice or hold himself out as qualified to practice medicine, osteopathy, chiropractic, or podiatry without obtaining a license from the Board of Medicine as provided in this chapter.
